title: 第三章 罗刹之貌
content_zh:
陈默是被一盆冷水浇醒的。

    刺骨的寒意让他猛地睁开眼，发现自己躺在一间土坯房的地上，周围围着十几个穿着粗麻布衣服的人，男女老少都有，正用惊恐又好奇的眼神盯着他。

    “你是何人？”一个留着络腮胡、身材壮硕的男人开口，说的竟是带着口音的中文。陈默愣住了，对方见他不说话，又问了一遍，这次口音更重了些。

    “我是……飞行员，飞机失事了，”陈默挣扎着坐起来，喉咙依旧干疼，“这里是哪里？”

    “飞行员？”络腮胡皱起眉，似乎没听过这个词，“这里是罗刹国，黑风村。”

    罗刹国？陈默心里咯噔一下。这个名字像一道闪电，劈开了记忆里的某个角落——小时候听爷爷讲过的传说，说西方有个国度，那里的人以丑为美，越丑的人地位越高，越俊的人反而被视为不祥。

    他下意识地摸了摸自己的脸。他不算顶帅，但也算眉目周正，常年飞行晒出的小麦色皮肤，轮廓分明。可此刻，他看到周围人的脸，突然明白了什么。

    那些人，有的眼睛挤成一条缝，有的鼻子歪向一边，有的嘴唇厚得像香肠，还有的脸上布满疙瘩——按照他的审美，确实称不上好看，甚至有些丑陋。可他们看他的眼神，却像在看一个怪物。

    “这人……长得真吓人。”一个老太太哆哆嗦嗦地说，躲到络腮胡身后。

    “是啊，皮肤这么光滑，眼睛这么大，莫不是妖怪变的？”

    “扔出去吧，别污了咱们村子的地！”

    议论声越来越大，带着敌意。陈默这才反应过来，在这个地方，他成了最丑的人。

    络腮胡名叫王大锤，是村里的地主，也是说话最有分量的人。他盯着陈默看了半晌，突然说：“等等，他穿的衣服好奇怪，身上还有铁家伙（指手表），说不定有点用处。”他指了指旁边的柴房，“先关起来，看看能不能干活。”

    陈默就这样被关进了柴房。里面阴暗潮湿，堆着干草和柴火，墙角还有老鼠跑过。他靠着墙坐下，心里一片茫然。飞机上的乘客还在等他，可他现在自身难保。罗刹国，以丑为美，这到底是什么地方？

    第二天一早，王大锤的女儿王丫来送吃的。那是个十七八岁的姑娘，眼睛小小的，鼻子有点塌，按照罗刹国的标准，算是中等样貌。她把一碗黑乎乎的糊糊放在地上，低着头不敢看陈默，声音细若蚊蚋：“爹说……让你今天去劈柴。”

    陈默拿起碗，闻了闻，一股粗粮的味道。他饿坏了，几口就吃了个精光。王丫见他吃完，飞快地收拾了碗，转身要走，却被陈默叫住：“这里……真的以丑为美吗？”

    王丫猛地转过身，脸涨得通红，像是被踩到了痛处：“你胡说什么！我们罗刹国的人，心灵最美！不像你们……你们这些长相怪异的，肯定心术不正！”她说完，气呼呼地跑了出去，柴房门被摔得震天响。

    陈默看着她的背影，苦笑了一下。看来，在这里的日子，不会好过了。
content_en:
Chen Mo was woken up by a basin of cold water.

    The biting cold made him open his eyes suddenly and found himself lying on the ground of an adobe house, surrounded by a dozen people in burlap clothes, men, women and children, all staring at him with frightened and curious eyes.

    "Who are you?" A sturdy man with a beard said, speaking in Chinese with an accent. Chen Mo was stunned. Seeing that he didn't speak, the other party asked again, this time with a heavier accent.

    "I'm... the pilot. The plane crashed." Chen Mo struggled to sit up, his throat still sore and dry, "Where is this place?"

    "Pilot?" The bearded man frowned, as if he had never heard of this word before, "This is Rakshasa Country, Black Wind Village."

    Rakshasa country? Chen Mo's heart skipped a beat. This name is like a bolt of lightning, cracking open a corner of my memory - a legend I heard from my grandfather when I was a child, saying that there is a country in the West where people regard ugliness as beauty. The uglier the person, the higher their status, and the more handsome the person is considered unlucky.

    He subconsciously touched his face. He wasn't the most handsome, but he had a well-proportioned face, and his wheat-colored skin was tanned by flying all the time, and he had clear contours. But at this moment, when he saw the faces of the people around him, he suddenly understood something.

    Some of those people's eyes were squeezed into slits, some had noses crooked to one side, some had lips as thick as sausages, and some had pimples on their faces—according to his aesthetics, they were indeed not good-looking, and even a little ugly. But the way they looked at him was like looking at a monster.

    "This man... looks really scary." An old lady said tremblingly, hiding behind her beard.

    "Yes, the skin is so smooth and the eyes are so big. Could it be that he turned into a monster?"

    "Throw it out, don't pollute the land of our village!"

    The chatter grew louder and more hostile. Only then did Chen Mo realize that he had become the ugliest person in this place.

    The bearded man's name is Wang Dachui. He is the landlord in the village and the person who speaks with the most weight. He stared at Chen Mo for a long time, and suddenly said: "Wait a minute, the clothes he is wearing are weird, and he has an iron thing on him (pointing to the watch), which may be of some use." He pointed to the woodshed next to him, "Lock him up first and see if he can work."

    Chen Mo was imprisoned in the woodshed. It was dark and damp inside, with piles of hay and firewood, and rats running across the corners. He sat down against the wall, feeling confused. The passengers on the plane are still waiting for him, but he can't protect himself now. Rakshasa country, where ugliness is considered beautiful, what kind of place is this?

    Early the next morning, Wang Dachui's daughter Wang Ya came to deliver food. She was a girl of seventeen or eighteen years old, with small eyes and a somewhat flat nose. According to the standards of the Rakshasa Kingdom, she was considered to be of average appearance. She put a bowl of dark paste on the ground and lowered her head, not daring to look at Chen Mo. Her voice was as thin as a gnat: "Dad... asked you to chop firewood today."

    Chen Mo picked up the bowl and smelled it, smelling of coarse grains. He was so hungry that he ate it all in just a few bites. Seeing that he had finished eating, Wang Ya quickly put away the bowl and turned to leave, but was stopped by Chen Mo: "Here... is it really that ugliness is considered beautiful?"

    Wang Ya turned around suddenly, her face flushed, as if she had been stepped on a painful spot: "What nonsense are you talking about! We, the people of the Rakshasa Kingdom, have the most beautiful souls! Unlike you...you guys with weird looks must have evil intentions!" After she finished speaking, she ran out angrily, and the woodshed door was slammed loudly.

    Chen Mo looked at her back and smiled bitterly. It seems that life here will not be easy.
